_about: Static (read-only) copy of the site: the one place that defines the precomputed grid and the file keys. Read by deploy/build_static_site.py and by frontend/src/staticSite.ts. Change it here, then rebuild with: python deploy/build_static_site.py

_keys.cashflow: POST /runs/{id}/cashflow -> /static-api/runs/{id}/cashflow/{key}.json. key = 'base' for no overrides; 'delay-{d}' for {delay_days: d} (d snapped to delay_days grid); 'rise-{p}' for index_rise_pa with every index in rise_pct.indices at p/100 (p snapped to rise_pct grid, written without trailing .0, e.g. rise-5, rise-7.5). Other overrides are not precomputed.
_keys.page: GET /packages/{pkg}/page/{doc}/{page}.png?highlight=h -> /static-pages/{pkg}/{doc}/{page}-{hash}.png, hash = FNV-1a 32-bit (8 lowercase hex chars) of the UTF-8 bytes of h cut to highlight_max_chars UTF-16 units (as the site cuts it). Listed in /static-api/pages.json only when the highlight changes the image; otherwise, and without highlight, /static-pages/{pkg}/{doc}/{page}.png.
